en.title: ee
en.summary: This is the letter L318 from the vowel-consonant groups.

sections.title: The letters ee
paragraphs: The letters ee make a vowel sound. A vowel is a sound made with open air and no touch in the mouth. You hear its main sound in (tree) /triː/, which means a tall plant with wood and leaves. This letter group makes two different sounds in English words.

sections.title: Mouth shape
paragraphs: For the first sound, lift the front of your tongue high and forward near the roof of your mouth. Spread your lips wide as if smiling. For the second sound, relax your lips and lower your tongue just a little bit. Place your hand on your throat to feel your voice shake for both sounds.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: In most words, these two letters make a long sound, as in (see) /siː/. You also hear this regular sound in (feed) /fiːd/. In a few uncommon words, the letters make a short sound, as in (been) /bɪn/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not shorten the main vowel when you read words with these letters. If you cut the vowel too short, (feed) /fiːd/ can sound like fit. Keep your lips spread wide and hold the vowel sound for more time.
